$comment: The catalog of language / API 'slots' the registry can map between. 'language' entries are general-purpose languages (their stdlib callables live in subsystem files like java.util.json); 'api' entries are libraries/subsystems (OpenGL, Direct3D). 'dialects' lists a language's versions OLDEST->NEWEST; a mapping row may carry 'by_version' overrides keyed by these ids, and the resolver picks the newest override at-or-below the requested target dialect. Add a slot here to open it for mapping rows; seed rows demand-driven as real code needs them.

java.desc: Java SE (source language of the Minecraft corpus).

asm.x86.desc: x86-64 assembly (target for lowered hot paths).

opengl.desc: OpenGL 1.x fixed-function pipeline (as exposed by LWJGL).

direct3d9.desc: Direct3D 9 + D3DX (the Xbox 360 realization of OpenGL).

javax.swing.desc: Java AWT/Swing desktop UI (mostly dead on console).
